sources.title: Arohan Financial Services Secures SEBI Approval For IPO Comprising ₹600 Crore Fresh Issue And OFS Of 4.04

synopsis: Microfinance institution Arohan Financial Services has secured SEBI approval for its initial public offering. The proposed IPO consists of a fresh issue worth ₹600 crore and an offer for sale of 4.04 crore shares by existing investors, which include US Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association, Michael & Susan Dell Foundation, Aavishkaar Goodwell India Microfinance Development Company-II Ltd, Tano Capital, TR Capital III Mauritius, and the Danish Sustainable Development Goals Investment Fund. Proceeds from the fresh issue are intended to strengthen the company's capital base and fund general corporate purposes. SEBI issued its final observation on November 13 after initial papers were filed in May. DAM Capital Advisors, Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors, and SBI Capital Markets are managing the issue.
